name: Qilu Bank Co., Ltd.
summary: Qilu Bank Co., Ltd. provides personal and corporate banking services in the People's Republic of China. The company offers personal savings products, including fixed deposits and withdrawals; personal demand, savings, personal notice deposits, and personal monthly profit; personal consumer loans, housing mortgage, consumer credit, home and home improvement, car, and other loans; wealth management services; credit cards; and insurance products. It also provides corporate loans; corporate deposits; and corporate financing; supply chain finance; bill of exchange; cash management integrated financial services; and investment banking products and services.
